title: Navet — Your Smart Home, in One Place | 1-Minute Tour
description:
Meet Navet: an open-source, self-hosted smart home dashboard for every screen.

Explore the live demo: https://demo.navet.app/
Install Navet: https://docs.navet.app/install/

This one-minute product film shows Navet's real demo interface: Home, Lighting, Climate, Security, Energy, Media, Household chores, Routines, and Appearance settings — followed by desktop, tablet, and phone layouts.

Navet works with Home Assistant, Homey, and openHAB. Feature availability varies by provider: https://docs.navet.app/integrations/

Website: https://navet.app/
Documentation: https://docs.navet.app/
Source code and contributions: https://github.com/awesomestvi/navet
Community: https://www.reddit.com/r/navet/

New to Navet? Watch the setup guide: https://youtu.be/XEjrLwt5xiQ

Visuals use authentic Navet demo data. Narration and instrumental music were created with ElevenLabs: https://elevenlabs.io/

#Navet #SmartHome #HomeAssistant
channelDescription:
A smart home dashboard for every screen. Open source. Self-hosted.

Navet brings everyday control of your home to wall panels, tablets, desktops, and phones. Connect Home Assistant, Homey, or openHAB and build a dashboard that fits your household. Feature availability varies by provider.

This is the official Navet channel: product tours, installation and setup guides, practical walkthroughs, and updates from the project.

Explore the live demo to see Navet in action. Use the documentation to get started, or join the community to share ideas and contribute.
